name: Forbidden Island
source:
Forbidden Island is a choice-driven visual novel focused on survival, trust, emotional conflict, and human relationships. The story branches into two different endings based entirely on the player’s decisions.

After a violent storm sinks a passenger ship in the Pacific Ocean, David — a ship mechanic — wakes up on a deserted island. There, he encounters John, who is injured, and John’s wife Georgia, both survivors of the same disaster. Later, the group finds and rescues Isabel, another castaway who washed ashore.

The four characters must work together to survive the island’s harsh conditions while dealing with their evolving emotions, personal struggles, and the pressure of finding a way back to civilization. As the player, you shape David’s actions, his relationships, and the direction of the entire story. Will David focus on pure survival, or will his emotional connections influence the choices he makes? Every decision matters and leads the story toward one of its multiple outcomes.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4105850/Forbidden_sland/]Steam[/url]]
